select vo.ORDER_ID as orderId, d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, cp.FINPROD_ID as prodId, cp.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderTypeCode, vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType, DATE_FORMAT(vo.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, IFNULL(tdf.FEE_AMT,'0') as tdFeeAmt, vo.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt, vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatusCode, vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatus from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d left join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join ( SELECT
trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' ) cp
on cp.finprod_id = '不进行关�?' inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id
inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} order by vo.SETTLE_DATE ASC

trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' ) cp
on cp.finprod_id = '不进行关�?' inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id
inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} order by vo.SETTLE_DATE ASC

trade_id FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ) e ON d.TRADE_ID=e.TRADE_ID left join
( SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID,FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT ACCT_SUBJECT_ID FINPROD_ID,ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME FINPROD_ABBR FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO WHERE ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE ='F18' )
zc on zc.finprod_id = '不进行关�?'
left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on d.trade_id = tdf.trade_id inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id
inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and vo.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} and d.finprod_type = 'C07'
